entries.what: The Coinbase Pro REST API at api.pro.coinbase.com. An unauthenticated GET /products on 2026-11-05 returned 503 with the body Coinbase Pro API is deprecated.
lookFor: A request to api.pro.coinbase.com, or a client pointed at it
entries.replacement: The Advanced Trade API for retail accounts, or the Exchange APIs for institutional clients.
requires: Pro API keys don't work with Advanced Trade, so new keys are needed and the code has to change with them.

entries.what: The Coinbase Pro price feed at ws-feed.pro.coinbase.com. The source covers the Pro product as a whole and doesn't name this host. A handshake on 2026-11-05 returned HTTP 530.

source.quote: Coinbase Pro has been disabled for use and all customers have been migrated as of December 1, 2023.

entries.replacement: The Advanced Trade API for retail accounts, or the Exchange APIs for institutional clients.
